questions.prompt: Ada has one banana. She eats the inside, drops the outside, then picks it up. A photograph is taken before the final action. What is on the ground in that photograph? 填2词，使用banana。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Jo says, “I carried the empty cup.” Ken says, “I took it from Jo and threw it behind the door.” Who dropped rubbish there? 只填文中人名。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: 8:00: a skin falls on the path. 8:01: a pupil slips and falls. 8:02: a helper removes it. Summary: Removing it did not prevent the pupil’s ______. 填1词，用fall的名词形式。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: At nine Sue swept the path. At ten a storm blew wrappers onto it. At eleven the path was littered again. Complete: The later mess can be explained by the ______, not proof that Sue did no work. 抄写1词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: A team jogs along the path, stopping briefly to collect litter as it goes. Another team finishes a run before starting a separate clean-up. Which team is plogging? 填 first 或 second。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Monday’s plan: “The rain will clean the path.” Tuesday’s check: “Mud still covers it.” A summary says, “The path is clean.” Is that a plan, a checked fact, or an unsupported claim? 填 unsupported claim，checked fact 或 plan。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The picking tool was developed in Town A. Town B tested it later; Town C now uses the most. Complete: The tool was first developed in Town ______. 填1个字母。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Supply list: silk ribbon—ties signs; bamboo pole—reaches high branches; paper card—writes messages. The team must move an empty bag caught above its reach. Which listed material will help? 填1个材料词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: After the event, the silk ribbons are undamaged and needed tomorrow, but the next group cannot find them. Should they be thrown away or arranged neatly? 用put, them, in, order组成4词写合理处置。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Team list: Ana, Bo and Cam. Ana texts them, “Bo is absent tomorrow. Cam and I will carry the bags.” Summary by Ana: “______ carry them; Bo will not.” 填1个含主语与will的缩写。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Noah’s sister will bring tools. A note tells Noah, “You’ll need the car to collect the younger pupils.” Another says, “He’ll pick them up.” Does He refer to Noah or his sister? 只填Noah或sister。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: “The bags are too heavy,” says May. Lee immediately takes one and says, “______ carry this one for you.” 填I will的缩写，不能填表示愿望的I’d。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Promise: “We won’t leave bottles or skins on the ground.” Afterwards all bottles are removed, but skins remain. Complete: The promise is broken because the ______ remain. 抄写1个复数名词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Before the clean-up the path is dirty. The team removes every wrapper and checks again. A report says, “The path will be dirty after our work.” 保留will be，只改最后1词使总结符合材料。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Plan: “No cups will remain on the benches. We will carry every cup to the bins.” Complete with leave: “We ______ cups on the benches.” 用will的否定缩写，填2词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Original note: “They will bring gloves.” Only Eli can come now. A pupil changes it to “Eli wills bring gloves.” Only one word is grammatically wrong. Write its correct form, not the wrong word itself.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Two gloves lie on the ground. Fran picks up the red one; the blue one stays there. “I’ll pick it up,” says Gus. Which colour glove does Gus mean? 填1个颜色词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Tasks: ① Pick up the bags beside the gate. ② Pick up the visitors at the station. The driver has just one job. Which task is the driver most likely to do? 填①或②。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Yara picked up a few greetings in English from daily contact. A report claims she learned the whole language fluently. Complete the cautious summary: She learned ______; full fluency is not proved. 抄写表示有限所学内容的3词短语。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The old bags have no holes. They are needed next week. Draft: “We will throw them away.” 在will后加1词使计划符合两条事实，不改其他词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: A pupil drops a wrapper beside the river. The wrapper lands on dry ground, never touches the water and is picked up at once. Which place briefly becomes littered? 填文中1词，不填river。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: An old man falls. The helper first gets him onto his feet and only then walks him home. Which action comes first? 用help, him, up组成3词，不增词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Dad drives Eva to the clean-up. After it, a friend walks Eva home because she has no bike. How does Eva travel home? 填2词，首词on。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: There are two bins: red is full; blue is empty. The rules say never put rubbish beside a full bin. A volunteer has another bag. Which bin can receive it now? 填1个颜色词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Team A collected ten tiny wrappers; Team B collected one huge sack. The report counts objects but gives no weights. To compare “more rubbish by weight”, the missing information is ______. 填文中1个复数名词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The first message says 9:00. The final message changes the meeting to 9:15. Uma arrives at 9:10. The leader says she is not late. Which message sets the time now? 填 first 或 final。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Meeting time: 8:30. Leo arrives at 8:40, but catches a falling box before it hurts anyone. Complete: He is late for the meeting, yet ______ to help. 填本单元2词短语，不填on time。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Visitors may not enter the school. The classroom door is inside; the main gate is on the street. Helpers must meet the visitors before they enter. Where should they wait? 填2词，以the开头，不写classroom。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Meet at the school gate, walk to Happy Park, then clean the pond path there. Finish at the library. Summary: The clean-up itself takes place in ______. 抄写2词专名。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Wet-floor notice: “Cleaning 9:00–9:20. Keep out until the floor dries at 9:30.” The visitors arrive at 9:25. Earliest entry: ______. 用原通知的数字时间。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: During one park jog, the team exercises and removes litter. These are not two separate sessions. Complete: The health benefit and cleaner path happen ______. 填本单元4词短语。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: If dry, the group will sweep the park. If wet, they will make posters indoors. Saturday is wet. Summary: The group changes its ______, but still does useful work. 从activity / members中选1词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: A volunteer must be free after 2:00 and bring gloves. Mia has gloves but must leave at 1:30; Ben is free all afternoon but has no gloves. How many qualify now? 填1个英文数词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: All brushes have been washed, but they are mixed with ropes in a box. The next group needs to find them quickly. Complete the remaining job: ______ the tools, rather than washing them again. 用organise的-ing形式填1词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Message 1 from Sol: “Our group cleans on Sunday.” Reply from Bea: “Can I join you?” Who asks for permission to join an existing group? 只填人名。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: “I’d love to come, but I must visit Grandma this Saturday. Please invite me next week.” Does the speaker reject the activity itself or only this date? 填 date 或 activity。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Nora says, “I’d like to start a cleaning group.” She has not invited anyone or held a meeting yet. Label its status: a ______, not a completed action. 从wish / result中选1词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The teacher praises the team: “You did a great job.” Evidence notes: A—promised to clean; B—removed litter and checked every path. Which note supports the praise of completed work? 填A或B。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The path is already spotless. A team patrols it all day, removing each new wrapper immediately. They do not change it from dirty to clean; they ______ it clean. 填keep或make。 （词注：spotless：一尘不染的。）

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Jae hears a proposed route and says, “That sounds great.” The route has not been tried. Complete: His words express a first ______, not a tested result. 从impression / measurement中选1词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Our jog made us fitter. We also filled two rubbish bags along the route. Summary: The activity helped our health and the ______. 填1词，使用city，不加冠词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: A: Wash hands before eating. B: Collect litter with gloves. C: Put the filled bags into bins. Finish both litter jobs before washing hands; filled bags exist only after collection. Write the required order of A, B, C, using hyphens.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Before work: visitors avoid the littered garden. After work: flowers are visible and visitors return. The evidence mainly shows a better public place, not a faster sport. 填 city 或 race 作为总结主题。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Diary: “I stayed home. Ben told me he swept the square.” Complete the evidence note: The writer ______ about the sweeping but did not see it. 从heard / watched中选1词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Plan: “If it rains, we’ll clean indoors; otherwise, we’ll go plogging.” A new message says rain is expected. Complete: The expected plan is cleaning ______. 填文中1词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Both teams remove old books from the shelf. Team A sends useful ones to another class; Team B sends useful ones to the rubbish bin. Which team avoids wasting usable books? 填A或B。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: A pupil sweeps wrappers off the visible floor into the space behind the door. No rubbish leaves the room. Complete: The rubbish is hidden, not ______. 从removed / made中选1词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Poster: “Only three helpers so far. Join us this Saturday!” It gives no results or photographs of completed work. Is its main purpose recruiting or reporting? 填1词。 （词注：recruiting：招募。）

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: “My bag has torn,” says Pat at the gate. Quin has a spare and immediately offers it. Complete Quin’s reply using lend: “I ______ you mine.” 用will填2词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Four named helpers are Asha, Ben, Cal and Dia. Cal cancels; Dia stays at the tool table. “They’ll clean the river bank” refers only to the remaining two. 写两个人名，用and连接，按原名单顺序。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: It is Friday 6 June. This weekend’s park event is cancelled; the same event moves to the following Saturday. The new date is Saturday ______ June. 填数字日期。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The cup breaks before Ali can catch it. Ali then removes the sharp pieces before anyone steps on them. It was too late to save the cup, but not too late to protect ______. 从people / cup中选1词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: First Saturday: park. Second: station. Third: park again. A summary says, “We never revisit a place.” Which Saturday provides a counterexample? 填first / second / third之一。 （词注：counterexample：反例。）

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: After three hours, our legs hurt. However, seeing the litter-free river made us smile. Complete the contrast: “We were tired ______ happy.” 从but / because中选1词，保留原转折关系。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Before trying plogging, Ren thought it was only running. Afterwards, he explained both running and collecting litter. Which belief belongs to the first stage: only running or both activities? 填 only running 或 both activities。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The tool is easy for adults but difficult for small children. The notice advises help for the latter. In the latter, which group is meant? 填2词，来自材料。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Final instruction: visitors wait outside the school gate. Draft: “They will wait in the classroom.” Replace in the classroom with the correct 4-word location, keeping the instruction that they must not enter the school.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Two signs read “Leave flowers growing” and “Put wrappers here”. One belongs by a flower bed; one on a rubbish bin. Which sign guides the correct disposal of litter? 抄写该标牌的3个词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The sign says, “Do not pick them; let them grow.” Nearby are flowers and fallen wrappers. What does them refer to? 从flowers / wrappers中选1词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Find one word from shirt, skirt, bird. It has /ɜː/ in the textbook’s British pronunciation, is clothing, and is not worn on the upper body. 填1词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The /ɜː/ word box has girl, bird, shirt and thirsty. A label says “Every word names a person, animal or piece of clothing.” Which word disproves that label? 填1词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Rule note: “In these stressed syllables, ir usually has /ɜː/.” A summary changes usually to always. Restore the one word that keeps the claim within the original evidence.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: British key: bird /bɜːd/, five /faɪv/, dirty /ˈdɜːti/. A pupil puts all three in one /ɜː/ vowel group. Which entry must be moved out? 填1词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Transcript: “I wheel clean the park tomorrow.” The recording uses /wɪl/, not /wiːl/, and announces a future action. Replace only wheel with the correct word.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Fact card: “Plogging began in Sweden. It combines jogging with litter collection.” A summary form asks for the individual inventor’s name. The card provides no personal name. Fill that field with the cautious 2-word label meaning 未提供。 Use not / given once each.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Draft: “Tomorrow we will clean the square.” Proposed ending: “We were tired but happy after the work.” To keep it a plan, should the ending describe a future hope or a past result? 填 future hope 或 past result。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Job list: ① Eat lunch. ② Remove dirty gloves. ③ Wash hands. The current order is ①→②→③. Put the same tasks in a safe order, finishing with lunch. 用①②③或1-2-3表示。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Six signed up. A photo at ten shows four, but no attendance record is given. Complete cautiously: “Four were in the photo; the others’ attendance is ______.” 从unknown / impossible中选1词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Notes: met at nine; jogged along the path; lifted litter into bags; put bags in bins. Summary: “We jogged and ______ rubbish.” 用pick的过去式构成2词，概括中间实际动作。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The notice says, “Park garden; start at nine.” It does not say when the event ends. Complete: We know the location and starting time, but cannot work out its ______. 从duration / location中选1词；duration意为持续时长。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Teacher: “You shouldn’t drop rubbish.” Pupil: “I won’t do it again.” Which speaker gives a personal future promise rather than advice? 填 teacher 或 pupil。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Plan: “We will clean and sort rubbish.” The group knows who will come and what to bring, but no meeting time is set. What must the organiser still confirm: when, who, or what to bring? 填1项英文。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Diary: “We cleaned the park yesterday. We have booked another session for next month.” Complete the resolution using help: “We ______ again next month.” 用will填2词。

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The shop has a green wall, but it gives every customer three new plastic bags. Another shop has a white wall and asks customers to bring their own bags. Which statement best explains a green shop?

inputs.label: 请选择正确答案
choices: A. It helps people use fewer resources.
B. Its walls must be green.
C. It gives people more plastic bags.
D. It sells only green vegetables.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The computer is still on, but everyone has finished using it. Mum asks Dan what he will do. Dan should say, “_____”

inputs.label: 请选择正确答案
choices: A. I will turn off it.
B. I will turn it off.
C. I will turn it on.
D. I will turns it off.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: It is dark in the room. Ada cannot read her homework. She will leave the room after finishing it. What should she do first?

inputs.label: 请选择正确答案
choices: B. Turn down the light on her paper.
D. Keep the room dark all evening.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The radio is useful for the lesson, but its music is too loud. “Please _____,” says the teacher.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The speaker is on. Children at the front can hear the story, but those at the back cannot. What does the teacher need to do?

inputs.label: 请选择正确答案
choices: B. Turn on the speaker again.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: “Save water at home” and “The nurse helped save the child” both use save. What does save mean in the second sentence?

inputs.label: 请选择正确答案
choices: B. Keep someone alive or safe.
C. Put money away for later.
D. Spend more time on something.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: For a new cloth bag, Leo puts two yuan into a box every Friday. He says, “I will save money.” Here save means _____.

inputs.label: 请选择正确答案
choices: B. use all the money at once
C. keep money for a later use
D. give the shop every coin today

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Nina is brushing her teeth. Water is running from the tap, but she is not using it now. Which action will save that water?

inputs.label: 请选择正确答案
choices: B. Leave the tap running and close the door.
C. Turn off the kitchen light only.
D. Turn off the tap until she needs water.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: One face of a sheet has a map; the other face has notes. Which sentence correctly describes the sheet?

inputs.label: 请选择正确答案
choices: A. We have used both sides of the paper.
B. We have used both side of the paper.
C. We have used both of sides of the paper.
D. We have used all three sides of the paper.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Kai writes 20 lines on one side of a sheet. He needs 20 more lines, and its other side is empty. Which plan uses the least new paper?

inputs.label: 请选择正确答案
choices: A. Take two new sheets for the extra lines.
B. Write the extra lines on the other side.
C. Throw away the first sheet and start again.
D. Use a new sheet and leave its back empty.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Mia has exactly two shopping bags. One is red and one is blue. _____ the bags are made of cloth.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: At lunch, Rob takes only the food he needs and finishes it. His friend takes too much and leaves half. Which sentence best describes Rob?

inputs.label: 请选择正确答案
choices: A. He must take more food to go green.
B. He wastes the food on his plate.
C. He turns up his food before lunch.
D. He eats up the food he takes.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: There are two small apples left. They are fresh, and the children are still hungry. Which instruction is correct?

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Choose the best line for a plan about tomorrow’s picnic.

inputs.label: 请选择正确答案
choices: A. We won’t waste foods on our plates.
D. We won’t to waste food.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: There is clean rainwater in a bucket. The gardener will use it for the flowers. Which sentence correctly refers to this particular water?

inputs.label: 请选择正确答案
choices: A. We will save a water in the bucket.
B. We will save waters in the bucket.
C. We will save the water in the bucket.
D. We will saving the water in the bucket.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: A shop gives customers many _____ bags. Which form fits the material before bags?

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: This shopping bag is soft. It is made from the same kind of material as a shirt, and Mum washes and uses it again. It is a _____ bag.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: Ella brushes her teeth twice a day. Tomorrow she will _____ them before leaving for camp.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The cook needs carrots, potatoes and tomatoes. The children will carry these _____ in a cloth bag.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The green club meets for _____ hour, not for a whole afternoon.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: The class starts a talk at 2:00 and finishes at 2:40. Every week, this talk _____ for forty minutes.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
questions.prompt: “The last game lasts ten minutes.” Which explanation is correct?

inputs.label: 请选择正确答案
choices: B. Both words are names of games.
C. The first last means final; lasts means continues for a time.
D. The first last means ten; lasts means minutes.

questions.sourceName: 课内考试拓展原创练习
